verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents Workflows, which 'automate machine learning tasks' as GPU-backed pipelines defined in code. That is a first-party automation capability, but the evidence never shows recurring schedules, event triggers, or unattended background operation. Auto-shutdown is only an adjacent inactivity control, and API/CLI access is a developer building block, so neither earns credit here. missing for 10: documented scheduling or triggers for Workflows, evidence of autonomous background execution without user intervention, depth of Workflows docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Workflows automate machine learning tasks, combining GPU instances with an expressive syntax to generate production-ready machine learning pipelines with a few lines of code.
